mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ), lease_version = lease_version + 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND scheduled_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED')
mapper.select: SELECT id AS instanceId, definition_id AS definitionId, scheduled_at AS scheduledAt, GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0) AS retryCount, max_retries AS maxRetries, attempt_count AS attemptNo, lease_version AS leaseVersion, lease_owner AS workerId, handler_type AS handlerType, payload AS payload FROM task_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_instance ( definition_id, user_id, scheduled_at, status, handler_type, payload, max_retries ) VALUES ( #{definitionId}, #{userId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status}, #{handlerType}, CAST(#{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON), #{maxRetries} )
mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT ti.id, ti.definition_id AS definitionId, ti.user_id AS userId, ti.scheduled_at AS scheduledAt, ti.attempt_count AS attemptCount FROM task_instance ti JOIN task_execution te ON te.instance_id = ti.id AND te.attempt_no = ti.attempt_count WHERE ti.status = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND te.status = 'FAILED' AND te.end_time IS NOT NULL AND te.end_time <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{delaySeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY te.end_time, ti.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance SET status = 'QUEUED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}
mapper.select: SELECT id, attempt_count AS attemptCount, max_retries AS maxRetries, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_until AS leaseUntil, lease_version AS leaseVersion FROM task_instance WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
